verdicts.reason: A is mostly a shrunk copy of the original: there is a large dead left margin (~130px before the quote mark), and the attribution, button label and Lumen & Fig logo are too small to read comfortably. Still, nothing collides and the original hierarchy and grouping survive. B makes the quote nicely large, but the attribution floats in the top middle, detached from its quote. The bottle is pushed off-centre so it straddles the circle's left edge, and the logo is jammed inside the circle beside the bottle, which reads as a collision. The quote also sits cramped against the left edge, and the composition looks scattered rather than intentional.
